description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。您可以从客户端生成一个不超过64个ASCII字符的参数值，并将值赋予ClientToken，保证重试请求的幂等性。更多详情，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: A token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client that contains up to 64 ASCII characters. This ensures that retried requests are idempotent. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh: 工作组描述。长度为 2～256 个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
description.en: The description of the workgroup. It must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
工作组名称。名称需满足以下要求：

- 任务名称必须唯一。
- 长度为2~64个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头，可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、点号（.）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the workgroup. The name must meet the following requirements:

- The workgroup name must be unique.

- The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 标签数组。数组长度：1~20。如果数组中有多个标签对象，标签键Key不允许重复。
description.en: An array of tags. The array can contain 1 to 20 tags. If the array contains multiple tags, the value of \`Key\` for each tag must be unique.

description.zh: 工作组的标签键。最多支持128个字符，一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`。
description.en: The tag key. It can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot be an empty string. The key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 工作组的标签值。最多支持128个字符，一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串，不能包含`http://`或`https://`。
description.en: The tag value. It can be up to 128 characters in length and can be an empty string. The value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

descriptions.zh:
- 每个阿里云账号最多可创建50个工作组。
- 一个工作组最多可以关联50个迁移源。
- 一个迁移源只能关联一个工作组。
descriptions.en:
- Each Alibaba Cloud account can have up to 50 workgroups.

- A single workgroup can be associated with up to 50 migration sources.

- A migration source can be associated with only one workgroup.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun smc create-workgroup --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --name testWorkgroupName --description test --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun smc CreateWorkgroup --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Description test --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --Name testWorkgroupName
